question: Among the same 18,890 executable 360-name breakout opportunities, does prioritizing the event closest to its frozen stop at the completed 12H confirmation close change the nine-slot cash account compared with farthest-risk-first and the frozen CRC32 admission order?
single_variable: Change only event ordering among opportunities with the same exact executable entry timestamp. Keep all native breakout paths, stop/exit prices, signal events, nine slots, cash sizing, fees, and already-open positions unchanged.

data.confirmation_price: Native UTC 12H close at key_open_ms + 12 hours; for the 69 documented H1-only archives, reuse the exact complete-12-hour aggregation used by the frozen historical experiment.
data.event_time: Only events with status=executed, arm=breakout, tp_r=0, is_control=false. entry_ms must equal confirmation_ms and key_open_ms + 12 hours.

close_risk_min.sort: For events at the same entry_ms, ascending side*(confirmed_12h_close-stop_price)/confirmed_12h_close.

close_risk_max.sort: For events at the same entry_ms, descending side*(confirmed_12h_close-stop_price)/confirmed_12h_close.

priority_policies.tie_break_for_both: CRC32(symbol), symbol, event_id ascending, matching the original deterministic wallet tie ordering.
priority_policies.crc32_original: Reuse the already-frozen 360-name CRC32 actual account receipt. Do not rerun its account.
priority_policies.risk_fraction_audit: Retain path risk_fraction (entry-open-to-stop percentage) for audit and compare its same-time ordering to the stricter confirmation-close ordering; it is not used by the primary priority variants.

account.positions: Existing positions are never replaced or resized. The original wallet.admit and VectorBT shared-cash account decide capacity and funding.
account.costs: OKX Lv1 taker 0.0005 per entry and market/stop/EMA/gap/tail exit. No resting-limit orders, added leverage, or slippage.

execution.admission_engine: Existing cloud_close_reward_account.admit; only entry_order is added for the two confirmation-close risk priority policies.
execution.account_engine: Existing VectorBT 1.2.0 cloud_close_reward_account.account_order with one nine-slot shared-cash account per alternate policy.

mini_check.fixture: 11 same-time candidates competing for nine open slots
mini_check.expected: Minimum confirmed-close stop-distance priority funds the nine smallest distances; maximum priority funds the nine largest; each rejects exactly two through the existing admission function.
